title: Bound closed-world relation compiler semantics before further expansion

masterplan.gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

issue_scope.priority: continue bounded Fourfold/Tensor kernel gardening without parallel abstractions

finding.closed_world_gap: The canonical strict Forest/Fourfold sparse projection requires both endpoint PlaneSnapshot values to be complete because TypedRelationBlock carries no completeness/status field and sparse zeroes cannot represent unknown partial/absent facts. The active multi-relation compile_relation_blocks owner validates Forest/Fourfold revision and membership but never inspects endpoint plane status; its focused regression fixture currently compiles Fourfold snapshots produced by the conservative legacy Forest adapter, which intentionally preserves incomplete assurance. This leaves a closed-world semantic gap: a partial observation can be materialized as an apparently exact sparse relation block.
finding.scalar_scope_gap: The strict canonical projection contract is Boolean-only until Forest weights, multiplicity, costs or evidence bundles have explicit scalar projection contracts. The multi-relation compiler currently admits boolean, natural and evidence-dag observers. This is retained as a separate follow-up question and is not bundled into this packet.

decision.summary: Freeze further relation-compiler feature expansion until the closed-world completeness boundary is reconciled in the existing owner. The next implementation packet should reject only requested/discovered relations whose endpoint planes are not complete, before Forest evidence materialization, while preserving explicit unrelated-plane selection and the GPU-41 selected-evidence pruning. It must reuse PlaneSnapshot.status and the existing compiler rather than add another adapter, compiler, status wrapper, cache, index, registry or semantic plane. Scalar observer admission remains a separate bounded packet so correctness domains are not conflated.
decision.gardener_note: Research boundary prevents another abstraction and identifies the smallest in-owner fail-closed change; no production file was touched.

focused_next_contracts: an explicitly requested relation refuses before _forest_edge_atoms when either endpoint plane is partial or absent
a selected relation with complete endpoint planes is not blocked merely because unrelated Fourfold planes are partial or absent
discover-all never emits a sparse block whose endpoint plane is incomplete
existing digest/revision, endpoint-membership, hyperedge refusal and selected-evidence-pruning contracts remain authoritative

claims.correctness: bounded semantic inconsistency identified and next fail-closed implementation scoped; production gap is not yet claimed fixed
